title: Jerry Lynn moves from challenger to world champion
summary: After proving himself against RVD, Jerry Lynn pursues ECW’s world championship. His breakthrough against Justin Credible is followed by a crowded battle for control of the title.

chapters.title: Lynn wins the world title
chapters.result: Lynn defeats Credible for the ECW World championship.
chapters.context: The victory in Minnesota gives the respected challenger his biggest ECW accomplishment.

chapters.title: Double Jeopardy ends Lynn’s reign
chapters.result: Corino wins the four-man Double Jeopardy championship match.
chapters.context: Lynn’s first reign ends amid overlapping rivalries with Credible, Corino and Sandman.
